messages:
marie: Quick update — Heliograph Labs signed off on the customer spotlight quote and gave final logos. They want a webinar + blog post. Embargo: 2026-04-10 09:00 PT. Need legal ok + PR copy by EOD tomorrow. Links: https://drive.redwood/heliograph-assets :sparkles:
sam: Nice! Can we align the benchmark narrative with the new batching numbers? I'll draft bullet points.
alex: I can share the benchmark snippets and a 30s demo clip. Will upload to the folder.
jordan: I'll review PR copy + quote usage. Marie, please ping me with the exact quote lines you plan to use.
marie: Copy below — please redline:
"Heliograph reduced inference costs by 42% using Redwood Dedicated, with 2.5x throughput improvements."
(also sent in the doc)
priya: Re inbound leads — please route webinar signups to my SDR queue (region: NA). Also want UTM tags + Sales sequence.
marie: Agreed. UTM pattern: ?utm_source=heliograph_webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=heliograph_april
sam: I'll add this to the registration page. @ops-bot can you confirm landing page slug?
ops-bot: Landing page created: /events/heliograph-spotlight-apr-2026 — live in staging.
marie: Timeline: PR copy by EOD tomorrow -> legal signoff by Friday morning -> embargo 2026-04-10 -> webinar 2026-04-14. Can we hit that?
jordan: Tight but doable. I'll prioritize and leave comments in the doc. Flagging one IP callout about 'throughput' claim.
alex: Noted — I'll provide the raw test logs for calibration.
priya: For lead routing: please set form field 'company_size' and 'use_case' so SDRs can triage. Also add hidden field 'utm_campaign'.
sam: Deploy snippet for hidden fields:
```
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_campaign\" value=\"heliograph_april\" />
<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"utm_source\" value=\"heliograph_webinar\" />
```
marie: @priya is the sales sequence template 'webinar-sdr-std'? use that.
priya: yes, but tweak to mention the specific benchmark stat. I'll prep copy.
meetings-bot: Webinar scheduled on Zoom for 2026-04-14 10:00 PT — invites sent to panelists.
marie: thanks. final ask: Marketing will own PR outreach list. @sam can you pull the analyst contacts? Also need a 1-page one-pager for sales handoff.
sam: On it. I'll export contacts and draft 1-pager by tomorrow noon.
marie: perfect. tagging for follow-ups: @jordan (legal), @alex (benchmarks), @sam (PR + one-pager), @priya (lead routing). :thumbsup: 
priya: Received. Will set up automation in Salesloft and confirm routing by EOD Friday.
marie: Great — will add final copy to drive and ping when ready. Thanks everyone :party: 
ops-bot: Upload: https://drive.redwood/heliograph/one-pager_v1.pdf (uploaded by marie)
marie: uploaded the final draft. Jordan, any blockers?
jordan: Minor edit to tweak language: replace 'reduced inference costs' with 'reduced per-token inference costs' and add source note. Other than that good to go.
marie: made the change. final doc link: https://drive.redwood/heliograph/final_pr_copy.docx
priya: Confirmed routing test — test lead created and assigned to SDR 'NA-webinars'.
sam: I'll prep the press list and a short embargoed email. Will share tomorrow.
marie: Closing loop: if legal signs off today, we'll lock assets and begin outreach tomorrow morning. Thanks all!
